build_rag_model: build a RagModel for retrieval-augmented generation using the TransformerGeneratorRagAgent or BartRagAgent
build_regret_model: build a ReGReT model from a pretrained checkpoint file to rank retrieved documents
compute_loss_rag: compute the loss for a RAG batch using the rag_model_interface and record retrieval metrics
generate_rag_response: generate a response using the RagAgent with retrieval-augmented beam search and optional ReGReT reranking
batchify_rag_observation: batchify observations into a RagAgent batch with query vectors and input turn counts
